Sandbox_SFL_Enabled_tooltip: Preserves the lunchbox and contents. Disabled intervals do not earn restoration credit.
Sandbox_SFL_BaseCapacity: Starting capacity of newly initialized lunchboxes
Sandbox_SFL_BaseCapacity_tooltip: Default 4, range 1–30. Applied only once to each new lunchbox. Existing boxes, upgrades and original-stat restoration are never overwritten by later sandbox changes.
Sandbox_SFL_RestoreHours: Game hours to restore one full fresh-life interval
Sandbox_SFL_RestoreHours_tooltip: Default 10, range 0.25–1000. Lower is faster. Each food uses its own native fresh-life threshold; this is not a fixed completion duration for every item.
Sandbox_SFL_AllowRotten_tooltip: Allows gradual recovery of rotten food that still exists. Burnt food, fertilized eggs and unsupported shelf-life types are excluded. Does not remove poison or contamination.
